description: Queue a report, native PowerPoint or saved Highlights video in a research session. Reuses saved reports and findings; no need to run exhaustive analysis first. Highlights follow default-report learning goals/quotes, with original audio when available and no artificial narration for chat studies; prompt does not select different quotes. Poll inspect_research_session view=job until succeeded; then read its output_id. Retry with the same key.

idempotency_key.description: Use a stable key for this operation and reuse it on retries with the same inputs.

include_synthetic.description: Include evidence from synthetic respondents alongside human interviews.

name.description: Display name for the research session or saved output.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

prompt.description: Natural-language question or instructions for the requested research task.

session_id.description: UUID of the research session, as returned by inspect_research_session.

template_id.description: Identifier returned by upload_research_template for a compatible template.

type.description: Type of saved output to generate.

name: generate_research_output
title: Generate Research Output
